waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: This check is a roll-up of the evidence sections. Eight sections passed with real lab evidence (alertLifecycle, alertParity with 3/3 detection pairs matching on all 7 strict-parity dimensions, dataConnectorIngestion with 3/3 connector queries passed, deployment and readback, imageRendering, mockIngestion, uiTraversal with 10/10 pages and 42/42 assertions passed, and workbookQualification with 11/11 workbook queries passing on both Log Analytics and Advanced Hunting). It fails only because urlVerification (QUAL-URL-01) is individually waived with documented evidence in this file. It adds no independent failure.

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: Browser and HTTP verification checked 28 URLs across the solution; 26 returned HTTP 200. The 2 non-200 URLs are pre-existing upstream entries in unchanged files: (1) https://your-domain.my.salesforce.com is a customer-supplied Salesforce tenant domain placeholder in the connector setup instructions, not a resolvable link by design; (2) https://www.salesforce.com/in/products/service-cloud/overview/ is an unchanged upstream Salesforce marketing URL that returns HTTP 403 to automated probes due to CDN bot protection. All aka.ms links, Microsoft Learn links, GitHub links, and SVG logo assets returned HTTP 200.

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: The 2 reported insecure-HTTP hits are JSON $schema identifiers in pre-existing, unchanged Azure Function connector files, not navigable documentation or logo links: http://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2015-01-01/deploymentTemplate.json# in Data Connectors/azuredeploy_Connector_Salesforce_Service_Cloud_AzureFunction.json and http://json.schemastore.org/proxies in Data Connectors/proxies.json. All 23 aka.ms short links and all documentation/logo URLs use valid HTTPS formatting.

waivers.author: solution-author
waivers.authorJustification: The 3 flagged files under Data Connectors/ (Data Connectors/host.json, Data Connectors/proxies.json, and Data Connectors/SalesforceSentinelConnector/function.json) are pre-existing Azure Function App runtime configuration files co-located under Data Connectors/, not Sentinel Data Connector definitions, and therefore legitimately do not contain connector id/title/dataTypes/instructionSteps properties. All actual Sentinel Data Connector definitions in the solution passed validation and were not modified by this migration.
